Who We Are

Nasugroup is a technology holding company that empowers businesses to harness the transformative power of artificial intelligence. Through our three specialized platforms, we deliver end-to-end AI solutions that address the most critical challenges facing modern enterprises: finding the right talent, optimizing business processes, and understanding customer sentiment in real-time.
